title: Plan-ledger evidence-ranked improvement roadmap

scoring_formula.scale: Each factor is scored 1-5 (higher is better except effort and migration risk).
notes: F=observed_frequency, I=user_impact, R=risk_reduction, T=measured_time_saved, E=implementation_effort, M=migration_risk, C=confidence.
Effort and migration risk are inverted so lower effort/risk raises the score.
External model/agent latency remains separate and is not counted as local product latency gains.

candidates.name: Enforce machine-checkable completion contract before acceptance

measured_time_saved_estimate.basis: 10 documented evidence-contract failures in retrospective pitfalls; estimate 15 minutes review/rework avoided per failure by pre-acceptance validator gate.

evidence.fact: Completion-contract/evidence omissions occurred in 10 documented failed or partial attempts.
Missing COMPLETION_JSON, missing terminal output, and absent acceptance items are repeatedly cited.
Historical verification handoff p50 is 81,342,013 ms, so reducing avoidable review loops matters.

candidates.target_behavior: A step cannot transition to accepted/done unless completion payload, evidence refs, acceptance checklist, and terminal report all validate against a deterministic schema.
contracts_and_api_changes: Add validator API `validateCompletionPayload(stepId, payload)` returning `{ ok, errors[], normalizedPayload }`.
Require non-empty command output snippets or explicit `output_redacted=true` marker for each reported command.
migration_and_backfill: Backfill historical rows with missing machine-checkable payloads to `validation_status='legacy_unknown'` (not `fail`).
Do not alter historical evidence content; only annotate validation status.
Expose backfill summary in audit command output.

tests.name: validator-rejects-missing-completion-json
tests.measurable_acceptance: Given missing completion payload fields, validator returns `ok=false` with >=1 explicit error code.

tests.name: step-cannot-terminalize-on-failed-validation
tests.measurable_acceptance: Attempting to mark step done with invalid payload returns non-zero exit and leaves step status unchanged.

tests.name: legacy-missing-payload-backfill-is-unknown-not-fail
tests.measurable_acceptance: Given legacy rows with no payload, backfill sets 100% of those rows to `legacy_unknown` and 0 rows to `fail`.

tests.name: validator-runtime-budget
tests.measurable_acceptance: Validation path p95 <= 2 ms per payload over 1,000 local iterations.

rollout: Ship validator in warn-only mode for one release.
Promote to hard-fail mode after zero false positives across 20 internal step completions.
rollback: Feature flag `PLAN_LEDGER_COMPLETION_GATE=enforce|warn|off` defaults to `warn` during rollout.
If blockage occurs, switch to `warn` without schema rollback.

performance_budget.local_latency: Validation adds <=2 ms p95 to step terminalization.
performance_budget.board_impact: No additional board startup work; startup remains <=120 ms p95.
performance_budget.external_latency_policy: No external model call in validation path.

risks: False-negative payload checks could block valid completions if schema is too strict.
If historical rows are misclassified during backfill, analysts may overstate failure rates; validator guard must enforce `legacy_unknown` semantics.
dependencies: Needs C4 telemetry event emission for validation failures.
Needs CLI and runner writers to emit completion payload v2.
non_goals: Changing user-authored narrative content in old records.

candidates.name: Auto-terminalize and reconcile stale active/draft plans

measured_time_saved_estimate.basis: 5 stale plans observed in retrospective headline counts; estimate 10 minutes operator triage avoided per stale plan.

evidence.fact: 5 out of 16 historical plans are stale.
Plans #8, #14, #15, and #16 are active despite all steps done; plan #11 is active with dormant in-progress final step.
Explicitly repeats active status contradiction for done-step plans.

candidates.target_behavior: Whenever a step enters a terminal state, the owning plan is automatically re-evaluated and terminalized (or flagged partial) within the same transaction boundary.
contracts_and_api_changes: Introduce `reconcilePlanTerminalState(planId)` and call it on every terminal step mutation.
Expose reconciliation summary in CLI and board APIs.
migration_and_backfill: Run one-shot reconciliation over plans #1-16 to set terminal metadata without rewriting step history.
Mark unresolved active+dormant plans as `stale_dormant` instead of forced done.

tests.name: active-plan-all-steps-done-autoterminalizes
tests.measurable_acceptance: After final step completion, plan status becomes done within same operation and contradiction count remains zero.

tests.name: deferred-gate-plan-marked-partial
tests.measurable_acceptance: If >=1 done step has deferred manual gate, plan status is `partial` and reason is `partial_due_to_deferred_gate`.

tests.name: reconcile-performance-budget
tests.measurable_acceptance: Reconciliation adds <=5 ms p95 for plans up to 100 steps.

rollout: Enable reconciliation in shadow mode and log old/new state decisions.
Flip to enforcing mode after validating no status regressions on seeded fixtures.
Run backfill once and capture before/after contradiction counts.
rollback: If incorrect transitions occur, disable gate and retain recorded diagnostics.

performance_budget.local_latency: Plan reconciliation mutation path <=5 ms p95.
performance_budget.board_impact: Board plan query remains <=1 ms p95 for API-level status fields.
performance_budget.external_latency_policy: No external model calls in reconciliation.

risks: Incorrect partial-vs-done inference if deferred metadata is inconsistent.
Backfill may surface latent inconsistencies that require manual review.
dependencies: Requires clear deferred/manual gate semantics from C1 contract payload.
Needs board badges from C4 for operator visibility.
non_goals: Changing intent of draft plans with zero execution evidence.

candidates.area: execution leases and stale recovery; runner/dispatch and role/model resolution
candidates.name: Policy-based dispatch with lease SLA and stale-step reassignment

measured_time_saved_estimate.basis: 5 role-mismatch recoveries; historical time_to_first_attempt p50 is 38.88 minutes, assume 25% reduction through task-fit dispatch and automatic stale reassignment.

evidence.fact: Role/model mismatch or stalled specialist dispatch appears in 5 documented recoveries.
Historical p50 time to first attempt is 2,332,838 ms.

candidates.target_behavior: Dispatcher selects executor role/model using task modality evidence, opens a lease with heartbeat SLA, and auto-reassigns steps when lease heartbeats or first artifact deadlines are missed.
contracts_and_api_changes: Add dispatch policy input contract `{ task_modality, required_artifact_type, preferred_role, fallback_roles[] }`.
Add lease policy contract `{ first_artifact_deadline_ms, heartbeat_interval_ms, stale_after_ms, max_auto_reassignments }`.
migration_and_backfill: No mutation of past assignment records; only append future reason-coded reassignments.

tests.name: dispatch-prefers-task-fit-role
tests.measurable_acceptance: Given implementation-modality workload with equal confidence inputs, implementer role score is >=1 point above architect role score.

tests.name: stale-lease-auto-reassignment
tests.measurable_acceptance: When heartbeat exceeds stale_after_ms, lease closes and next assignment emits `lease_timeout` reason.

tests.name: lease-path-performance-budget
tests.measurable_acceptance: Lease open/heartbeat/close p95 remain <=2.5 ms each across 30 local samples.

rollout: Start with advisory dispatch scoring logs while preserving current behavior.
Enable auto-reassignment for one plan cohort with max_auto_reassignments=1.
Expand after no regression in completion success rate for 20 consecutive steps.
rollback: Disable auto-reassignment and revert to manual dispatch if false positives appear.
Keep lease telemetry for diagnosis even when automation is off.

performance_budget.local_latency: Policy evaluation <=1 ms p95; lease operations <=2.5 ms p95.
performance_budget.board_impact: No board startup regression beyond current 117.28 ms p95 budget.
performance_budget.external_latency_policy: External model startup (about 1.0-1.4 seconds) is tracked separately and not treated as local regression.

risks: Incorrect policy features can over-bias toward one role.
Auto-reassignment can cause churn if stale thresholds are too aggressive.
dependencies: Needs C4 telemetry to calibrate stale thresholds.
Benefits from C1 completion contract to detect artifact deadline misses.
non_goals: Automatic quality judgment of finished artifacts.

candidates.name: Record execution activity and surface recovery status on board

measured_time_saved_estimate.basis: 0 activity records across 101 steps; estimate 10 minutes diagnosis saved for each of 10 correction episodes when timeline telemetry exists.

evidence.fact: Activity/lease observability gap: 0 activity records across 101 steps.
Activity column is zero for all plans.
Board startup is the top local bottleneck; observability changes must stay within budget.

candidates.target_behavior: Every assignment lifecycle emits activity start/heartbeat/failure/reassignment/completion events and the board renders concise status badges with drill-down history.
contracts_and_api_changes: Define activity event schema with required `event_type`, `step_id`, `assignment_id`, `timestamp`, and `metadata`.
Add board API endpoint `/api/activity/latest` with plan and step scope filters.
schema_changes: Ensure `activity_runs` creation on assignment start is mandatory.
Add index on `(step_id, started_at)` for activity query speed.
migration_and_backfill: Backfill synthetic `activity_backfill_missing` event for historical steps with no activity rows.
Do not fabricate detailed historical timelines.

tests.name: activity-events-emitted-for-lifecycle
tests.measurable_acceptance: Assignment start->completion emits >=4 ordered events with non-null timestamps.

tests.name: board-shows-stale-badge
tests.measurable_acceptance: Within <=1 refresh cycle, a step with stale lease appears with `stale_lease` badge in board API and UI rendering.

tests.name: telemetry-path-performance-budget
tests.measurable_acceptance: activity_append_event remains <=1 ms p95 and board startup remains <=120 ms p95.

rollout: Enable event writes first, then enable board badge reads.
Audit event volume and index hit rates before default-on UI exposure.
Keep badge rendering behind feature flag for first release candidate.
rollback: Disable badge rendering independently from event writes.
If write pressure rises, switch to sampled activity emission.

performance_budget.local_latency: Event append <=1 ms p95; board meta/plans/detail endpoints stay <=1 ms p95.
performance_budget.board_impact: Board server startup must not exceed 120 ms p95.
performance_budget.external_latency_policy: No dependence on external model calls for board telemetry.

risks: Event volume can increase storage churn without retention policy.
Badge semantics may confuse users without concise legend text.
dependencies: Needs C3 lease reason codes for stale badge accuracy.
Needs C1 validation failure event type for evidence-gate visibility.
non_goals: Building a full observability analytics warehouse.
Real-time websocket streaming in first release.

candidates.name: Typed carry-forward fields and required next-owner summary

measured_time_saved_estimate.basis: One explicit malformed carry-forward value (`undefined`) plus broader handoff hygiene issues.

evidence.fact: Carry-forward hygiene pitfall cites malformed value and schema-validation need.

candidates.name: Legacy verification provenance labeling and confidence downgrades

measured_time_saved_estimate.basis: 54 legacy_unknown completed steps and 101/101 zero claimed artifacts increase audit ambiguity.

evidence.fact: Legacy verification/artifact provenance gap documents 54 legacy_unknown done steps and zero claimed artifacts.

candidates.name: Long-lived JSON bridge process to amortize startup overhead

measured_time_saved_estimate.basis: Performance analysis fixed overhead estimates implied CLI work overhead at 15.18 ms p50.

evidence.fact: Warm round-trip still carries measurable fixed overhead.

candidates.name: Board startup and roster query tuning with explicit guardrails

measured_time_saved_estimate.basis: Performance analysis estimates board startup has 43.76 ms p50 potential savings.

evidence.fact: Board startup is currently top local bottleneck at 103.76/117.28 ms p50/p95.
External model startup remains approximately 1.0-1.4 s and is tracked separately.

first_release.name: R1 governance-and-recovery foundation
first_release.coherence_rationale: These four items jointly prevent incomplete acceptance, auto-correct stale state, recover stalled execution, and make failures visible. They address the repeated high-frequency evidence and state pitfalls before lower-yield latency tuning.
release_non_goals: No dependence on external model startup optimization.

limitations: This roadmap is based on supplied audit artifacts and benchmark outputs only.
Time-saved estimates are directional planning inputs, not guarantees.
Historical handoff timings include human and external-agent delays and are intentionally separated from local product latency.
